description: Fix 5 issues found in semantic review: (1) campaign_applications INSERT missing required fields, (2) ensureUserProfile/ensureWallet race condition - use upsert, (3) admin actions silently swallow errors, (4) payout_details type mismatch - serialize as JSONB, (5) deposit/withdrawal DTOs missing required fields (id, brand_name, user_name, user_role).
steps: STEP 1 - Fix CampaignRepository.applyToCampaign to pass all NOT NULL columns (id, campaign_title, brand_name, creator_id, creator_name, creator_handle, fee_requested) and use status 'submitted' instead of 'pending'. Update CampaignViewModel.applyToCampaign signature to pass campaign item data.
STEP 2 - Fix UserRepository.ensureUserProfile to use upsert with onConflict='id' instead of check-then-insert.
STEP 3 - Fix WalletRepository.ensureWallet to use upsert with onConflict='user_id' instead of plain insert.
STEP 4 - Fix AdminViewModel actions (approveKyc, rejectKyc, approveWithdrawal, rejectWithdrawal, approveDeposit, rejectDeposit) to surface errors in _uiState.

STEP 5 - Fix WithdrawalInsertDto.payout_details to use kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject for proper JSONB serialization. Add missing fields: id, user_name, user_role. Fix DepositInsertDto to add missing fields: id, brand_name.
acceptance_criteria: campaign_applications INSERT includes id, campaign_id, campaign_title, brand_name, creator_id, creator_name, creator_handle, fee_requested, pitch, and status='submitted'
Admin action errors are surfaced in AdminUiState.error
WithdrawalInsertDto.payout_details is serialized as a JSON object
DepositInsertDto has id and brand_name fields
WithdrawalInsertDto has id, user_name, and user_role fields
verification: Manual code review - cannot compile in sandbox (no Android SDK)
findings: All 5 issues from the semantic review have been addressed. Build verification cannot be performed (no Android SDK, network blocked). Code changes follow existing patterns and use APIs consistent with Supabase Kotlin BOM 3.0.2. The upsert API uses onConflict parameter. JsonObject from kotlinx.serialization.json is used for JSONB column serialization. The io.github.jan.supabase.auth.auth extension import was added to CampaignRepository for auth user access.
